_llm_instructions: Fill out the 'value' properties for each field in this Assumption Log template based on the provided project context.

Category.guidance: The category of the assumption or constraint

Assumption/constraint.guidance: A description of the assumption or constraint

Responsible party.guidance: The person who is tasked with following up on the assumption to validate if it is true or not

Due date.guidance: The date by which the assumption needs to be validated

Actions.guidance: Actions that need to be taken to validate assumptions

Status.guidance: The status of the assumptions, such as active, transferred, or closed

Comments.guidance: Any additional information regarding the assumption or constraint
